name: writematrix
expr: fname = [tempname '.csv']; writematrix([1 2; 3 4], fname); s = fileread(fname); delete(fname); r1 = double(strlength(s) >= 7);
comment: Side-effect smoke test (file I/O round-trip in single snippet via tempname). writematrix writes CSV -- file should have >= 7 chars (e.g. '1,2\n3,4\n').
